number.description: Observed one-based part number; no missing part is inferred.

revision.description: Exact decimal revision; not a JavaScript floating-point number.

BilibiliSnapshot.description:
Submitted values, not verified remote facts. None means not acquired;
Some("") and Some(vec![]) preserve observed emptiness.

DomainDiagnostic.description: Typed failures retain the owner boundary, including nested commit uncertainty.

environment.description: Present only when this process explicitly overrides the captured setting.

byte_count.description: Exact nonnegative decimal integer, never a JavaScript floating-point number.

ImportRequest.description: An intentional import submission. Reuse its ID only with identical arguments.

request_id.description: Canonical hyphenated UUID, scoped to the supplied backend run.

source_path.description: Absolute local source path. Copying preserves the source.

MediaSettingsRuntime.description:
Captured is the saved startup value; changes to saved values do not reconfigure
this run. Effective paths also include explicit process environment overrides.

locator.description: Run-scoped opaque locator; does not pin cache bytes. GET never regenerates.

completed.description: Missing values mean unknown progress, not zero.

entity_ids.description: One result per input position, including duplicate identities. No item quota.
Caller-selected identities, with one ordered result per input including duplicates.

revision.description: Canonical positive decimal, retained as a string to preserve integer precision.

extraction_version.description: Bump when projection meaning or exact normalization changes.

Search_Value.description: Decimal strings preserve the full integer range across JSON consumers.

active_operations.description: Includes private direct-response work until actual queue completion.

TaskOperation.description: Accepted business scope, independent of display labels and execution stages.

TaskSnapshot.description: Complete replacement projection. Reconnect replaces the prior baseline.

revision.description: Exact monotonically increasing decimal revision within this run.

TwitterCaptureIssue.description: A producer-reported failure/unavailability, not a backend diagnosis.

TwitterMediaClaims.description: Claims remain scoped to the group containing them; no intrinsic facts are written.

capture_local_id.description: Producer-local identifier, never promoted into a platform media ID.

source_order.description: Explicitly observed zero-based source order, never inferred from array position.

revision.description: Exact decimal revision; not a JavaScript floating-point number.

TwitterSnapshot.description:
Submitted observations, never independently verified remote facts.
`None` means not acquired; `Some("")` and `Some(vec![])` retain observed emptiness.

observed_at_unix_ms.description: Producer's observation time, Unix milliseconds; not backend acceptance time.

published_at_unix_ms.description: Producer-reported post publication time, Unix milliseconds; never inferred.

requested_url.description: The producer's requested URL, which need not be the subject post page.

expected_revision.description:
Canonical positive decimal through 9223372036854775807. Null or omitted
requires no saved preference; it never means unconditional overwrite.

view_definition_id.description: Opaque retained definition identity; unavailable definitions remain valid.
